   163	-- The generic family theorem elaborates a dependent presentation for every finite tag.
   164	/-- All chart rings and all exact pair-overlap rings are simultaneously defined over one
   165	finite subextension of an algebraic field extension `k/F`.  This is the complete object layer
   166	for the chosen affine gluing datum; its restriction maps and equations must still be spread out. -/
   167	theorem exists_finSubext_pic0FiniteStageAtlas_ring_models

     8	/-!
     9	# Pair-transition maps in the finite-stage Picard atlas
    10	
    11	The ordered overlaps `U ∩ V` and `V ∩ U` in the exact separably closed Picard atlas are
    12	canonically identified by restriction along `inf_comm`.  This file adds those transition
    13	maps to the already descended restriction legs and spreads the entire finite family out over
    14	one common finite subextension.  At that stage the restriction legs are open immersions and
    15	the two transition directions are inverse.
    16	
    17	This is not yet a `Scheme.GlueData`.  Its triple-overlap objects are pullbacks of restriction
    18	legs, and constructing their `t'` maps and cyclic cocycle is the next boundary.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace TensorProduct
    26	open scoped TensorProduct
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	noncomputable section
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    35	
    36	/-! ## Exact pair transitions -/
    37	
    38	/-- The finite family of ordered pairs indexing overlap-transition maps. -/
    39	abbrev Pic0FiniteStageTransitionIndex :=
    40	  Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C × Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C
    41	
    42	/-- The source ring of the transition indexed by `(U, V)` is the reversed overlap ring. -/
    43	def Pic0FiniteStageTransitionSource (p : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionIndex C) :
    44	    Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C :=
    45	  Sum.inr (p.2, p.1)
    46	
    47	/-- The target ring of the transition indexed by `(U, V)` is the forward overlap ring. -/
    48	def Pic0FiniteStageTransitionTarget (p : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionIndex C) :
    49	    Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C :=
    50	  Sum.inr p
    51	
    52	/-- The algebra map underlying the canonical transition from the reversed ordered overlap
    53	to the forward ordered overlap.  On schemes, `Spec.map` reverses this direction. -/
    54	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTransition
    55	    (p : Pic0FiniteStageTransitionIndex C) :
    56	    Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Pic0FiniteStageTransitionSource C p) →ₐ[k]
    57	      Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Pic0FiniteStageTransitionTarget C p) := by
    58	  rcases p with ⟨U, V⟩
    59	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
    60	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
    61	  have hUVVU : U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1 ≤ V.1.1 ⊓ U.1.1 := by
    62	    rw [inf_comm]
    63	  exact
    64	    { J.left.resHom hUVVU with
    65	      commutes' := fun r =>
    66	        J.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE hUVVU).op r }
    67	
    68	/-- Reversing an exact pair transition gives its inverse. -/
    69	theorem pic0FiniteStageTransition_inverse
    70	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    71	    (pic0FiniteStageTransition C (V, U)).comp
    72	        (pic0FiniteStageTransition C (U, V)) =
    73	      AlgHom.id k (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C V U) := by
    74	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
    75	  intro x
    76	  change
    77	    ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.resHom
    78	      (show V.1.1 ⊓ U.1.1 ≤ U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1 by rw [inf_comm]))
    79	      (((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.resHom
    80	        (show U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1 ≤ V.1.1 ⊓ U.1.1 by rw [inf_comm])) x) = x
    81	  rw [Scheme.resHom_resHom, Scheme.resHom_self]
    82	
    83	/-! ## One finite family of restrictions and transitions -/
    84	
    85	/-- A finite index type containing every restriction leg and every pair transition. -/
    86	abbrev Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex :=
    87	  Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C ⊕ Pic0FiniteStageTransitionIndex C
    88	
    89	/-- Source-ring tag for the combined finite family. -/
    90	def Pic0FiniteStageMapSource :
    91	    Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C → Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C
    92	  | Sum.inl i => Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionSource C i
    93	  | Sum.inr p => Pic0FiniteStageTransitionSource C p
    94	
    95	/-- Target-ring tag for the combined finite family. -/
    96	def Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget :
    97	    Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C → Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C
    98	  | Sum.inl i => Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionTarget C i
    99	  | Sum.inr p => Pic0FiniteStageTransitionTarget C p
   100	
   101	/-- The exact combined family: restrictions on the left summand and pair transitions on the
   102	right summand. -/
   103	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageMap
   104	    (q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C) :
   105	    Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[k]
   106	      Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q) := by
   107	  rcases q with i | p
   108	  · exact pic0FiniteStageRestriction C i
   109	  · exact pic0FiniteStageTransition C p
   110	
   111	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000 in
   112	-- The quotient presentation creates a dependent module instance for every ring tag.
   113	/-- The chosen finite-presentation model ring at a further finite subextension. -/
   114	abbrev Pic0FiniteStageModelRing
   115	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
   116	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
   117	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
   118	    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
   119	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
   120	    (j : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) : Type u :=
   121	  M.1 ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   122	    (n j) (m j) (relation j)
   123	
   124	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000 in
   125	-- Both dependent tensor-product instances must elaborate before the conjugated map.
   126	/-- The exact combined-family map transported to the ambient tensor-product models. -/
   127	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap
   128	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
   129	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
   130	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
   131	    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
   132	    (e : ∀ j,
   133	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
   134	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
   135	    (q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C) :
   136	    k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   137	        (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   138	        (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   139	        (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)) →ₐ[k]
   140	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   141	        (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   142	        (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   143	        (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)) :=
   144	  (e (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)).symm.toAlgHom.comp
   145	    ((pic0FiniteStageMap C q).comp
   146	      (e (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)).toAlgHom)
   147	
   148	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000 in
   149	-- The source and target quotient algebras depend on the ordered chart pair.
   150	/-- The transported ambient transitions in opposite directions are inverse. -/
   151	theorem pic0FiniteStageTransportedTransition_inverse
   152	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
   153	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
   154	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
   155	    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
   156	    (e : ∀ j,
   157	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
   158	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
   159	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   160	    (pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e (Sum.inr (V, U))).comp
   161	        (pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e (Sum.inr (U, V))) =
   162	      AlgHom.id k
   163	        (k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   164	          (n (Sum.inr (V, U))) (m (Sum.inr (V, U)))
   165	          (relation (Sum.inr (V, U)))) := by
   166	  change
   167	    ((e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm.toAlgHom.comp
   168	        ((pic0FiniteStageTransition C (V, U)).comp
   169	          (e (Sum.inr (U, V))).toAlgHom)).comp
   170	        ((e (Sum.inr (U, V))).symm.toAlgHom.comp
   171	          ((pic0FiniteStageTransition C (U, V)).comp
   172	            (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).toAlgHom)) = _
   173	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
   174	  intro x
   175	  change
   176	    (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm
   177	      (pic0FiniteStageTransition C (V, U)
   178	        ((e (Sum.inr (U, V)))
   179	          ((e (Sum.inr (U, V))).symm
   180	            (pic0FiniteStageTransition C (U, V)
   181	              ((e (Sum.inr (V, U))) x))))) = x
   182	  rw [(e (Sum.inr (U, V))).apply_symm_apply]
   183	  have htransition :=
   184	    DFunLike.congr_fun (pic0FiniteStageTransition_inverse C U V)
   185	      ((e (Sum.inr (V, U))) x)
   186	  calc
   187	    _ = (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm ((e (Sum.inr (V, U))) x) := by
   188	      exact congrArg (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm htransition
   189	    _ = x := (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm_apply_apply x
   190	
   191	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000 in
   192	-- The conclusion contains one dependent quotient-algebra instance for every finite tag.
   193	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   194	-- The simultaneous descent and equation reflection require a larger elaboration budget.
   195	/-- All exact restriction and pair-transition maps have simultaneous models over one finite
   196	subextension.  The restriction legs remain open immersions, and opposite transition maps
   197	are inverse at that same finite stage. -/
   198	theorem exists_finSubext_pic0FiniteStageTransition_models
   199	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k] :
   200	    ∃ (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
   201	      (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
   202	      (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
   203	      (e : ∀ j,
   204	        k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
   205	          Pic0FiniteStageRing C j),
   206	      ∃ (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
   207	        (mapM : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
   208	          Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
   209	              (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
   210	            Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
   211	              (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)),
   212	        (∀ q,
   213	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
   214	              (AlgHom.id L.1
   215	                (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   216	                  (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   217	                  (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   218	                  (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))))).comp
   219	              ((mapM q).restrictScalars L.1) =
   220	            ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e q).restrictScalars
   221	              L.1).comp
   222	              (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
   223	                (AlgHom.id L.1
   224	                  (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   225	                    (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   226	                    (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   227	                    (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)))))) ∧
   228	        (∀ i : Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C,
   229	          IsOpenImmersion
   230	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (mapM (Sum.inl i)).toRingHom))) ∧
   231	        (∀ U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C,
   232	          (mapM (Sum.inr (V, U))).comp (mapM (Sum.inr (U, V))) =
   233	            AlgHom.id M.1
   234	              (Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M (Sum.inr (V, U)))) := by
   235	  classical
   236	  obtain ⟨L, n, m, relation, e, _, _⟩ :=
   237	    exists_finSubext_pic0FiniteStageRestriction_openImmersion_models
   238	      (C := C) (F := F)
   239	  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
   240	    DatG0.exists_finSubext_tensorProduct_algHom_finite_of_models
   241	      (F := L.1) (K := k)
   242	      (fun q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C =>
   243	        DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   244	          (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   245	          (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   246	          (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)))
   247	      (fun q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C =>
   248	        DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   249	          (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   250	          (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   251	          (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)))
   252	      (fun q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C =>
   253	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   254	      (fun q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C =>
   255	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   256	      (fun q => e (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   257	      (fun q => e (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   258	      (pic0FiniteStageMap C)
   259	  choose mapM hmapM using hM
   260	  refine ⟨L, n, m, relation, e, M, mapM, hmapM, ?_, ?_⟩

     8	/-!
     9	# Assembly of the finite-stage Picard glue datum

    12	pair and triple transitions satisfy the five hypotheses of
    13	`AlgebraicJacobian.affineRingGlueData`.  This file packages those inputs into a scheme
    14	glue datum.

    52	-- The five dependent tensor-product coherence fields elaborate in one constructor term.

    55	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageAffineRingGlueData
    56	    (e : forall j,
    57	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]

    59	    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic M.1 k]

    61	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
    62	          (AlgHom.id L.1
    63	            (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
    64	              (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    65	              (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))

    73	                (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))

    78	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (mapM (Sum.inl i)).toRingHom)))

    82	        N.1 ⊗[M.1] Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
    83	          C L n m relation M mapM p)
    84	    (hthetaN : forall p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C,

    86	          (AlgHom.id M.1
    87	            (Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
    88	              C L n m relation M mapM p))).comp

    91	          C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2).restrictScalars
    92	            M.1).comp
    93	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val

    99	    Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing C L n m relation M N U

   107	    pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap (r U V)

   109	    pic0FiniteStageTransitionBaseChange C L n m relation M mapM N U V
   110	  let theta : ∀ U V W,
   111	      AlgebraicJacobian.AffineTripleTensor A B V W U →ₐ[N.1]
   112	        AlgebraicJacobian.AffineTripleTensor A B U V W := fun U V W =>
   113	    pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition
   114	      C L n m relation M mapM N thetaN U V W

   116	    (R := N.1) A B tau theta ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
   117	  · intro U
   118	    exact isIso_pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange_diagonal
   119	      C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM N U
   120	  · intro U V
   121	    exact isOpenImmersion_pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
   122	      C L n m relation M mapM hOpen N U V
   123	  · intro U
   124	    exact pic0FiniteStageTransitionBaseChange_self

   133	            C L n m relation M mapM N U V)

   138	      (pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition
   139	        C L n m relation M mapM N thetaN U V W).comp
   140	          ((pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition
   141	            C L n m relation M mapM N thetaN V W U).comp
   142	            (pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition

const code = `import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageAffineBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluingBaseChange

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]

namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

noncomputable def restrictionBaseChangeMapTest
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ⟶
      pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) :=
  affineBaseChangeMap P.N.1 k
    (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U)
    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V)
    (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V)

noncomputable def chartRingBaseChangeIsoTest
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ≅
      Spec (.of (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)) :=
  affineBaseChangeIso P.N.1 k
      (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U) ≪≫
    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
      (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e P.M P.N
          (Sum.inl U)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op

noncomputable def overlapRingBaseChangeIsoTest
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ≅
      Spec (.of (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)) :=
  affineBaseChangeIso P.N.1 k
      (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V) ≪≫
    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
      (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e P.M P.N
          (Sum.inr (U, V))).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
theorem rawTest
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    restrictionBaseChangeMapTest C P U V ≫
        (chartRingBaseChangeIsoTest C P U).hom =
      (overlapRingBaseChangeIsoTest C P U V).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V).toRingHom) := by
  simp only [restrictionBaseChangeMapTest, chartRingBaseChangeIsoTest,
    overlapRingBaseChangeIsoTest, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [affineBaseChangeIso_naturality]
  rw [cancel_epi]
  sorry

end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
end
end AlgebraicGeometry
`;
const r=await tools.mcp__lean_lsp__lean_run_code({code});
for (const c of (r.content||[])) if (c.type==="text") text(c.text);

    10	/-!
    11	# Stacks: effectiveness of descent
    12	
    13	Let `C` be a category with a Grothendieck topology `J` and `F : LocallyDiscrete Cᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat`.
    14	In this file, we define the typeclass `F.IsStack J` saying that `F` is a stack for `J`.
    15	(See the terminological note in the file `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Descent/IsPrestack.lean`:
    16	we do not require that the categories `F.obj (.mk (op S))` are groupoids.)
    17	
    18	The typeclass `IsStack` extends `IsPrestack`. The effectiveness of descent that
    19	is required for stacks is expressed by saying that the functors `toDescentData`
    20	attached to covering sieves are essentially surjective. Together with the
    21	`IsPrestack` assumption, we get that these functors are actually equivalences of
    22	categories (see `isEquivalence_toDescentData`). Conversely, we provide a
    23	constructor `IsStack.of_isStackFor` which assumes that these functors are
    24	equivalences of categories.
    25	
    26	## References
    27	* [Jean Giraud, *Cohomologie non abélienne*][giraud1971]
    28	* [Gérard Laumon and Laurent Moret-Bailly, *Champs algébriques*][laumon-morel-bailly-2000]
    29	
    30	-/
    31	
    32	public section
    33	
    34	universe t t' v' v u' u
    35	
    36	namespace CategoryTheory
    37	
    38	open Bicategory
    39	
    40	namespace Pseudofunctor
    41	
    42	variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    43	
    44	/-- The property that a pseudofunctor `F : LocallyDiscrete Cᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat`
    45	has effective descent for a Grothendieck topology, i.e. is a stack.
    46	(See the terminological note in the introduction of the file
    47	`Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Descent/IsPrestack.lean`.) -/
    48	@[stacks 026F]
    49	class IsStack (F : LocallyDiscrete Cᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{v', u'}) (J : GrothendieckTopology C) : Prop
    50	    extends F.IsPrestack J where
    51	  essSurj_of_sieve (F) {S : C} (R : Sieve S) (hR : R ∈ J S) :
    52	    (F.toDescentData (fun (f : R.arrows.category) ↦ f.obj.hom)).EssSurj
    53	
    54	variable (F : LocallyDiscrete Cᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{v', u'}) {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    55	
    56	/-- Version of `isStackFor` for a sieve instead of a presieve. -/
    57	lemma isStackFor' [F.IsStack J] {S : C} (R : Sieve S) (hR : R ∈ J S) :
    58	    F.IsStackFor R.arrows := by
    59	  rw [isStackFor_iff]
    60	  have hF := (F.isPrestackFor' _ hR).fullyFaithful
    61	  have := hF.full
    62	  have := hF.faithful
    63	  have := IsStack.essSurj_of_sieve F _ hR
    64	  exact { }
    65	
    66	lemma isStackFor [F.IsStack J] {S : C} (R : Presieve S) (hR : Sieve.generate R ∈ J S) :
    67	    F.IsStackFor R := by
    68	  simpa using F.isStackFor' _ hR
    69	
    70	lemma isEquivalence_toDescentData [F.IsStack J]
    71	    {ι : Type t} {S : C} {X : ι → C} (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ S) (hf : Sieve.ofArrows _ f ∈ J S) :
    72	    (F.toDescentData f).IsEquivalence := by
    73	  rw [← isStackFor_ofArrows_iff, ← IsStackFor_generate_iff]
    74	  exact F.isStackFor _ (by simpa)
    75	
    76	variable {F} in
    77	lemma IsStack.of_isStackFor
    78	    (hF : ∀ (S : C) (R : Sieve S) (_ : R ∈ J S), F.IsStackFor R.arrows) :
    79	    F.IsStack J where
    80	  toIsPrestack := .of_isPrestackFor (fun _ _ hR ↦ (hF _ _ hR).isPrestackFor)
    81	  essSurj_of_sieve R hR := by
    82	    have := (isStackFor_iff _ _).1 (hF _ _ hR)
    83	    infer_instance
    84	
    85	end Pseudofunctor
    86	
    87	end CategoryTheory

    26	/-- Pulling an isomorphism along a pseudofunctor map produces an isomorphism. -/
    27	noncomputable instance LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom_isIso
    28	    {X₁ X₂ : C₀} {M₁ : F₀.obj (.mk (op X₁))} {M₂ : F₀.obj (.mk (op X₂))}
    29	    {Y : C₀} {f₁ : Y ⟶ X₁} {f₂ : Y ⟶ X₂}
    30	    (φ : (F₀.map f₁.op.toLoc).toFunctor.obj M₁ ⟶
    31	      (F₀.map f₂.op.toLoc).toFunctor.obj M₂)
    32	    [IsIso φ] {Y' : C₀} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (gf₁ : Y' ⟶ X₁) (gf₂ : Y' ⟶ X₂)
    33	    (hgf₁ : g ≫ f₁ = gf₁ := by cat_disch)
    34	    (hgf₂ : g ≫ f₂ = gf₂ := by cat_disch) :
    35	    IsIso (pullHom φ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂) := by
    36	  let a := (F₀.mapComp' f₁.op.toLoc g.op.toLoc gf₁.op.toLoc
    37	    (by rw [← Quiver.Hom.comp_toLoc, ← op_comp, hgf₁])).hom.toNatTrans.app M₁
    38	  let b := (F₀.map g.op.toLoc).toFunctor.map φ
    39	  let c := (F₀.mapComp' f₂.op.toLoc g.op.toLoc gf₂.op.toLoc
    40	    (by rw [← Quiver.Hom.comp_toLoc, ← op_comp, hgf₂])).inv.toNatTrans.app M₂
    41	  have ha : IsIso a := by dsimp only [a]; infer_instance
    42	  have hb : IsIso b := by dsimp only [b]; infer_instance
    43	  have hc : IsIso c := by dsimp only [c]; infer_instance
    44	  have hbc : IsIso (b ≫ c) := @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ b c hb hc
    45	  have habc : IsIso (a ≫ b ≫ c) :=
    46	    @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ a (b ≫ c) ha hbc
    47	  have h : pullHom φ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂ = a ≫ b ≫ c := by rfl
    48	  exact h ▸ habc

public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.Shapes.Pullback.HasPullback

/-!
# Pasting lemma

This file proves the pasting lemma for pullbacks. That is, given the following diagram:
```
  X₁ - f₁ -> X₂ - f₂ -> X₃
  |          |          |
  i₁         i₂         i₃
  ∨          ∨          ∨
  Y₁ - g₁ -> Y₂ - g₂ -> Y₃
```
if the right square is a pullback, then the left square is a pullback iff the big square is a
pullback.

## Main results
* `pasteHorizIsPullback` shows that the big square is a pullback if both the small squares are.
* `leftSquareIsPullback` shows that the left square is a pullback if the other two are.
* `pullbackRightPullbackFstIso` shows, using the `pullback` API, that
  `W ×[X] (X ×[Z] Y) ≅ W ×[Z] Y`.
* `pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso` shows, using the `pullback` API, that
  `(X ×[Z] Y) ×[Y] W ≅ X ×[Z] W`.

-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

universe w v₁ v₂ v u u₂

namespace CategoryTheory.Limits

variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]

section PasteLemma
section PastePullbackHoriz

/- Let's consider the following diagram
```
X₁ - f₁ -> X₂ - f₂ -> X₃
|          |          |
i₁         i₂         i₃
↓          ↓          ↓
Y₁ - g₁ -> Y₂ - g₂ -> Y₃
```
where `t₁` denotes the cone corresponding to the left square, and `t₂` denotes the cone
corresponding to the right square.
-/

variable {X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : C} {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂} {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Y₃} {i₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃}

/-- The `PullbackCone` obtained by pasting two `PullbackCone`'s horizontally -/
abbrev PullbackCone.pasteHoriz
    (t₂ : PullbackCone g₂ i₃) {i₂ : t₂.pt ⟶ Y₂} (t₁ : PullbackCone g₁ i₂) (hi₂ : i₂ = t₂.fst) :
    PullbackCone (g₁ ≫ g₂) i₃ :=
  PullbackCone.mk t₁.fst (t₁.snd ≫ t₂.snd)
    (by rw [reassoc_of% t₁.condition, Category.assoc, ← t₂.condition, ← hi₂])

variable (t₂ : PullbackCone g₂ i₃) {i₂ : t₂.pt ⟶ Y₂} (t₁ : PullbackCone g₁ i₂) (hi₂ : i₂ = t₂.fst)

local notation "f₂" => t₂.snd
local notation "X₁" => t₁.pt
local notation "i₁" => t₁.fst
local notation "f₁" => t₁.snd

variable {t₁} {t₂}

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
/-- Given
```
X₁ - f₁ -> X₂ - f₂ -> X₃
|          |          |
i₁         i₂         i₃
↓          ↓          ↓
Y₁ - g₁ -> Y₂ - g₂ -> Y₃
```
Then the big square is a pullback if both the small squares are.
-/
def pasteHorizIsPullback (H : IsLimit t₂) (H' : IsLimit t₁) : IsLimit (t₂.pasteHoriz t₁ hi₂) := by
  apply PullbackCone.isLimitAux'
  intro s
  -- Obtain the lift from lifting from both the small squares consecutively.
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂, hl₂'⟩ := PullbackCone.IsLimit.lift' H (s.fst ≫ g₁) s.snd
    (by rw [← s.condition, Category.assoc])
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁, hl₁'⟩ := PullbackCone.IsLimit.lift' H' s.fst l₂ (by rw [← hl₂, hi₂])
  refine ⟨l₁, hl₁, by simp [reassoc_of% hl₁', hl₂'], ?_⟩
  -- Uniqueness also follows from the universal property of both the small squares.
  intro m hm₁ hm₂
  apply PullbackCone.IsLimit.hom_ext H' (by simpa [hl₁] using hm₁)
  apply PullbackCone.IsLimit.hom_ext H
  · dsimp at hm₁
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hi₂, ← t₁.condition, reassoc_of% hm₁, hl₁', hi₂, hl₂]
  · simpa [hl₁', hl₂'] using hm₂

variable (t₁)

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
/-- Given
```
X₁ - f₁ -> X₂ - f₂ -> X₃
|          |          |
i₁         i₂         i₃
↓          ↓          ↓
Y₁ - g₁ -> Y₂ - g₂ -> Y₃
```
Then the left square is a pullback if the right square and the big square are.
-/
def leftSquareIsPullback (H : IsLimit t₂) (H' : IsLimit (t₂.pasteHoriz t₁ hi₂)) : IsLimit t₁ := by
  apply PullbackCone.isLimitAux'
  intro s
  -- Obtain the induced morphism from the universal property of the big square
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ := PullbackCone.IsLimit.lift' H' s.fst (s.snd ≫ f₂)
    (by rw [Category.assoc, ← t₂.condition, reassoc_of% s.condition, ← hi₂])
  refine ⟨l, hl, ?_, ?_⟩
  -- To check that `l` is compatible with the projections, we use the universal property of `t₂`
  · apply PullbackCone.IsLimit.hom_ext H
    · simp [← s.condition, ← hl, ← t₁.condition, ← hi₂]
    · simpa using hl'
  -- Uniqueness of the lift follows from the universal property of the big square
  · intro m hm₁ hm₂
    apply PullbackCone.IsLimit.hom_ext H'
    · simpa [hm₁] using hl.symm
    · simpa [← hm₂] using hl'.symm

/-- Given that the right square is a pullback, the pasted square is a pullback iff the left
square is. -/
def pasteHorizIsPullbackEquiv (H : IsLimit t₂) : IsLimit (t₂.pasteHoriz t₁ hi₂) ≃ IsLimit t₁ where
  toFun H' := leftSquareIsPullback t₁ _ H H'
  invFun H' := pasteHorizIsPullback _ H H'
  left_inv _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  right_inv _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _

end PastePullbackHoriz

events.text: The generic stack API and the project descent datum do line up categorically: `DescentData'` is equivalent to Mathlib’s ordinary `DescentData`. The missing question is effectivity for schemes, so I’m now checking whether the project’s separate finite-Galois quotient route already bypasses that gap, and exactly what finite-stage data remain before it yields `RepresentableBy`.

     8	/-!
     9	# The finite-stage Picard glue as a scheme over its field of definition
    10	
    11	The finite-stage glue package already contains affine algebras over its final finite
    12	subextension `P.N.1`.  Their structure maps agree on overlaps, so they descend to the
    13	glued scheme.  This retains the finite-stage object over `Spec P.N.1`, which is the
    14	object-level input for the scalar-extension comparison with the separably closed atlas.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    22	open scoped TensorProduct
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    29	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    30	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    31	
    32	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    33	
    34	set_option linter.style.setOption false
    35	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    36	-- Projecting the dependent scalar towers from `P` requires a larger local synthesis budget.
    37	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    38	/-- The structure map from the finite-stage glued scheme to its field of definition. -/
    39	noncomputable def gluedMap
    40	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    41	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    42	    P.glueData.glued ⟶ Spec (.of P.N.1) := by
    43	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.L.1 k := by infer_instance
    44	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.M.1 k := by infer_instance
    45	  let A : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Type u := fun U =>
    46	    Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U
    47	  let B : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Type u :=
    48	    fun U V =>
    49	      Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V
    50	  let r : ∀ U V, A U →ₐ[P.N.1] B U V := fun U V =>
    51	    pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
    52	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V
    53	  letI : ∀ U V, Algebra (A U) (B U V) := fun U V =>
    54	    pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap (r U V)
    55	  letI : ∀ U V, IsScalarTower P.N.1 (A U) (B U V) := fun U V =>
    56	    pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap (r U V)
    57	  let tau : ∀ U V, B V U →ₐ[P.N.1] B U V := fun U V =>
    58	    pic0FiniteStageTransitionBaseChange
    59	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V
    60	  fapply Multicoequalizer.desc
    61	  · intro U
    62	    change Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C at U
    63	    exact Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A U)))
    64	  · rintro ⟨U, V⟩
    65	    change Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C at U V
    66	    change
    67	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A U) (B U V))) ≫
    68	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A U))) =
    69	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau U V).toRingHom) ≫
    70	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A V) (B V U)))) ≫
    71	            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A V)))
    72	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    73	    rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    74	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    75	    congr 1
    76	    ext x
    77	    simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    78	      ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    79	      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, Category.assoc, RingHom.coe_coe]
    80	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1 (A U) (B U V)]
    81	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1 (A V) (B V U)]
    82	    exact (tau U V).commutes x |>.symm
    83	
    84	/-- The finite-stage Picard glue, retained over the finite field `P.N.1`. -/
    85	noncomputable def gluedOver
    86	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    87	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) : Over (Spec (.of P.N.1)) :=
    88	  Over.mk P.gluedMap
    89	
    90	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    91	
    92	end
    93	
    94	end AlgebraicGeometry

const code = `import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageAffineBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluingBaseChange

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000
set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]

namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

noncomputable def restrictionBaseChangeMapTest
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ⟶
      pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) :=
  affineBaseChangeMap P.N.1 k
    (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U)
    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V)
    (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V)

noncomputable def chartRingBaseChangeIsoTest
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ≅
      Spec (.of (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)) :=
  affineBaseChangeIso P.N.1 k
      (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U) ≪≫
    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
      (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e P.M P.N
          (Sum.inl U)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op

noncomputable def overlapRingBaseChangeIsoTest
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ≅
      Spec (.of (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)) :=
  affineBaseChangeIso P.N.1 k
      (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V) ≪≫
    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
      (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e P.M P.N
          (Sum.inr (U, V))).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op

theorem rawTest
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    restrictionBaseChangeMapTest C P U V ≫
        (chartRingBaseChangeIsoTest C P U).hom =
      (overlapRingBaseChangeIsoTest C P U V).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V).toRingHom) := by
  simp only [restrictionBaseChangeMapTest, chartRingBaseChangeIsoTest,
    overlapRingBaseChangeIsoTest, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [affineBaseChangeIso_naturality]
  rw [cancel_epi]
  sorry

end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
end
end AlgebraicGeometry

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChange

/-!
# Base change of the finite-stage Picard charts

Each chart inclusion in the finite-stage glue lies over its affine structure map.
After extending from the final finite subextension to the separably closed field,
the affine pullback formula and the final ring comparison identify that chart with
the corresponding chart in the exact Picard atlas.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]

namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
-- Projecting the package retains the nested finite-subextension scalar towers.
set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
/-- Every finite-stage chart inclusion lies over the chart's affine structure map. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem glueData_ι_gluedMap
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap P.N.1
          (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
            C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))) := by
  unfold gluedMap
  exact Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
-- The composite infers the same nested tensor-product instances as the ring comparison.
set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
/-- Base change of a finite-stage affine chart recovers the corresponding chart in the
exact separably closed Picard atlas. -/
noncomputable def chartBaseChangeIso
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap P.N.1
            (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ≅
      (pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover C).X U :=
  pullbackSymmetry _ _ ≪≫
    pullbackSpecIso P.N.1 k
      (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U) ≪≫
    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
      (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e P.M P.N
          (Sum.inl U)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op ≪≫
    U.1.2.isoSpec.symm

end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChange

/-!
# Naturality of affine scalar extension

For an algebra map A -> B, base change carries Spec B -> Spec A to the
contravariant Spec of the scalar-extended algebra map.  The tensor factors are
ordered with the extension ring on the left, matching the finite-stage Picard
ring comparisons.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

variable (R K A B : Type u)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
variable [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

/-- The affine base-change isomorphism with the extension ring as the left
tensor factor. -/
noncomputable def affineBaseChangeIso :
    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) ≅
      Spec (.of (K ⊗[R] A)) :=
  pullbackSymmetry _ _ ≪≫ pullbackSpecIso R K A

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineBaseChangeIso_inv_fst :
    (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          A →ₐ[R] K ⊗[R] A).toRingHom) := by
  simp [affineBaseChangeIso]

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd :
    (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom :
          K →+* K ⊗[R] A)) := by
  simp [affineBaseChangeIso]

/-- Base change of an affine morphism over Spec R. -/
noncomputable def affineBaseChangeMap (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) ⟶
      pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) :=
  pullback.map _ _ _ _
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom)) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
    (by
      rw [Category.comp_id, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
      congr 2
      exact phi.comp_algebraMap.symm)
    (by simp)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineBaseChangeMap_fst (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom) := by
  unfold affineBaseChangeMap
  exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineBaseChangeMap_snd (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      pullback.snd _ _ := by
  unfold affineBaseChangeMap
  rw [pullback.lift_snd]
  simp

set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
-- Both pullback projections expand tensor-product universal maps.
/-- The affine base-change isomorphisms intertwine a base-changed morphism with
the Spec of its scalar extension. -/
theorem affineBaseChangeIso_naturality (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).hom =
      (affineBaseChangeIso R K B).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
            (R := R) (K := K) phi).toRingHom) := by
  rw [← cancel_epi (affineBaseChangeIso R K B).inv]
  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [← cancel_mono (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, affineBaseChangeMap_fst]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_fst_assoc (R := R) (K := K) (A := B)]
    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_fst (R := R) (K := K) (A := A)]
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 2
  · rw [Category.assoc, affineBaseChangeMap_snd]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd (R := R) (K := K) (A := B)]
    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd (R := R) (K := K) (A := A)]
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 2
    ext x
    simp [AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom]

end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# A finitely presented Picard representative preserves filtered base colimits
    11	
    12	Representability turns the fixed-base Picard-zero functor into the functor of morphisms to its
    13	representing scheme.  If that scheme is locally of finite presentation, the scheme-theoretic
    14	finite-stage factorization and equality theorems show that this functor preserves the filtered
    15	colimits occurring in `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit`.

    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    26	/-- A locally finitely presented scheme representing `pic0TypeFunctor C` discharges the
    27	fixed-base filtered-colimit residual `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C`. -/

    29	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    32	    (J : Over (Spec (.of k))) (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
    33	    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation J.hom] :
    34	    Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C := by
    35	  intro I _ _ S h_aff hcompact hqs _
    36	  letI : IsConnected I := IsCofiltered.isConnected I
    37	  let D := S ⋙ Over.forget (Spec (.of k))
    38	  let t : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj (Spec (.of k)) :=
    39	    { app := fun i => (S.obj i).hom
    40	      naturality := fun {i j} f => by
    41	        change (S.map f).left ≫ (S.obj j).hom = (S.obj i).hom ≫ 𝟙 _
    42	        rw [Category.comp_id]
    43	        exact Over.w (S.map f) }
    44	  let c : Cone D := (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapCone (limit.cone S)
    45	  have hc : IsLimit c :=
    46	    isLimitOfPreserves (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))) (limit.isLimit S)
    47	  letI {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j) : IsAffineHom (D.map f) := h_aff f
    48	  letI (i : I) : CompactSpace (D.obj i) := hcompact i
    49	  letI (i : I) : QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i) := hqs i
    50	  refine preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone
    51	    (K := S.op) (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) (limit.isLimit S).op ?_
    52	  refine Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' (S.op ⋙ pic0TypeFunctor C)
    53	    ((pic0TypeFunctor C).mapCocone (limit.cone S).op) ?_ ?_
    54	  · intro x
    55	    let a : limit S ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm x
    56	    have ha : c.π ≫ t = (Functor.const I).map (a.left ≫ J.hom) := by
    57	      ext i
    58	      change (limit.π S i).left ≫ (S.obj i).hom = a.left ≫ J.hom
    59	      rw [Over.w (limit.π S i), Over.w a]
    60	    obtain ⟨i, g, hg, hgbase⟩ :=
    61	      Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation
    62	        D t J.hom c hc a.left ha
    63	    let g' : S.obj i ⟶ J := Over.homMk g hgbase
    64	    refine ⟨op i, rep.homEquiv g', ?_⟩
    65	    change x = (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (limit.π S i).op (rep.homEquiv g')
    66	    rw [← rep.homEquiv_comp]
    67	    rw [show x = rep.homEquiv a from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply x).symm]
    68	    apply congrArg rep.homEquiv
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact hg.symm
    71	  · intro ii x y hxy
    72	    let i := unop ii
    73	    let a : S.obj i ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm x
    74	    let b : S.obj i ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm y
    75	    have ha : t.app i = a.left ≫ J.hom := (Over.w a).symm
    76	    have hb : t.app i = b.left ≫ J.hom := (Over.w b).symm
    77	    have habOver : limit.π S i ≫ a = limit.π S i ≫ b := by
    78	      apply rep.homEquiv.injective
    79	      rw [rep.homEquiv_comp, rep.homEquiv_comp,
    80	        rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply, rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    81	      exact hxy
    82	    have hab : c.π.app i ≫ a.left = c.π.app i ≫ b.left :=
    83	      congrArg Over.Hom.left habOver
    84	    obtain ⟨j, hji, heq⟩ :=
    85	      Scheme.exists_hom_comp_eq_comp_of_locallyOfFiniteType
    86	        D t J.hom c hc a.left b.left ha hb hab
    87	    refine ⟨op j, hji.op, ?_⟩
    88	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (S.map hji).op x =
    89	      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (S.map hji).op y
    90	    rw [show x = rep.homEquiv a from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply x).symm,
    91	      show y = rep.homEquiv b from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply y).symm,
    92	      ← rep.homEquiv_comp, ← rep.homEquiv_comp]
    93	    apply congrArg rep.homEquiv

  refine ?_ ≫ (pullbackSymmetry _ _).hom
  refine ?_ ≫ (pullbackRightPullbackFstIso _ _ _).inv
  refine pullback.map _ _ _ _ (pullbackSymmetry _ _).hom (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) ?_ ?_
